Colourblind-Safe Discrete Palette for Single-Cell QC

Source: R/scale_prepro.R
prepro_pal.Rd

Returns the package's categorical colour vector, designed for the sample counts single-cell experiments actually produce – a 10x Flex pool can carry 16 samples, well past the 8 hues most palettes offer.

Usage

prepro_pal(n = NULL)

Arguments

n

Number of colours to return. NULL (default) returns the full vector. If n exceeds the number of available colours the palette wraps, which is worth avoiding: beyond ~24 groups, facet the plot instead.

Value

A character vector of hex colour codes.

Details

If dittoSeq is installed, dittoSeq::dittoColors() supplies the colours: an Okabe-Ito colourblind-safe base of 8, extended to 40 by stepping each hue darker and lighter. Otherwise an equivalent 24-colour vector built the same way is used, so the package has no hard Bioconductor dependency and figures stay reproducible either way.

Colours are assigned in fixed order, never recycled by rank – the same sample keeps the same colour when other samples are filtered out of a plot.

See also

scale_fill_prepro() and scale_colour_prepro(), which apply this palette to a plot; theme_prepro() for the matching theme.

Examples

prepro_pal(4)
#> [1] "#E69F00" "#56B4E9" "#009E73" "#F0E442"
length(prepro_pal())
#> [1] 40
